title: Delayed landing position update causes movement desync
explanation: After the player spawns at (200,760) a fall is started (frame 226) and the player lands at (200,799.99) (frame 234). However the next state snapshot (frame 240) already shows the player on the floor, but a separate "player_moved" event later at frame 255 reports a movement from (200,760) to (200,799.99), indicating the internal position was still recorded at the pre‑fall height until that frame. This lag creates a brief desynchronisation between physics and event logging, which could manifest as a visual stutter or delayed response when the player lands. The issue is not covered by the active checks (which monitor bounds, score, deaths, velocity limits, FPS, and coin counts).
